mapper.select: SELECT a.token_sn , a.admin_id , a.user_id , a.prgrm_id , a.updt_token_cn , a.acs_token_cn , a.in_admin_id , TO_CHAR(a.in_datetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') , a.up_admin_id , TO_CHAR(a.up_datetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM drugsafe_token a WHERE 1=1 AND a.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY a.token_sn DESC

SELECT a.token_sn , a.admin_id , a.user_id , a.prgrm_id , a.updt_token_cn , a.acs_token_cn , a.in_admin_id , TO_CHAR(a.in_datetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') , a.up_admin_id , TO_CHAR(a.up_datetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM drugsafe_token a WHERE 1=1 AND a.admin_id = #{adminId} AND a.del_yn = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE drugsafe_token SET token_sn = COALESCE(#{tokenSn}, token_sn) , admin_id = COALESCE(#{adminId}, admin_id) , user_id = COALESCE(#{userId}, user_id) , prgrm_id = COALESCE(#{prgrmId}, prgrm_id) , updt_token_cn = COALESCE(#{updtTokenCn}, updt_token_cn) , acs_token_cn = COALESCE(#{acsTokenCn}, acs_token_cn) , up_admin_id = COALESCE(#{upAdminId}, up_admin_id) , up_datetime = now() WHERE 1=1 AND admin_id = #{adminId}

UPDATE drugsafe_token SET token_sn = COALESCE(#{tokenSn}, token_sn) , admin_id = COALESCE(#{adminId}, admin_id) , user_id = COALESCE(#{userId}, user_id) , prgrm_id = COALESCE(#{prgrmId}, prgrm_id) , updt_token_cn = COALESCE(#{updtTokenCn}, updt_token_cn) , acs_token_cn = COALESCE(#{acsTokenCn}, acs_token_cn) , up_admin_id = COALESCE(#{upAdminId}, up_admin_id) , up_datetime = now() WHERE 1=1 AND user_id = #{userId}
